_comment: Rationale for these keys lives in core/pipeline.py, in the comment block immediately above _render_fcl_overrides (Task 14, lifted from Task 13's STAGE_FCL["run1b_mubeam"]). Edit that comment block, not this note, when the rationale changes. desc_fmt/output_glob/njobs (Task 6, lifted from the retired STAGES["run1b_mubeam"] literal) are per-stage orchestration constants -- desc_fmt is the json2jobdef description format, output_glob is the file pattern this stage emits regardless of geometry, njobs is the default grid job count (mode specs may override via run.jobs_per_stage; see core/pipeline.py stage_cfg()).
